title.en: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Transitional and Savings Provisions) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Transitional and Savings Provisions) Order.

heading.en: Deposit under repealed Act for rectifying common property defects

text.en:
2. Where any deposit is made by a developer under section 16(1) or (5) of the repealed Act, and the deposit has not been refunded in accordance with section 16(6) of the repealed Act before 1st April 2005, that deposit —
(a)need not be refunded immediately on 1st April 2005; but
(b)shall continue to be dealt with by the Commissioner in accordance with section 16(4) and (6) of the repealed Act as if the Act had not been enacted.
[G.N. No. S 200/2005]
